newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers hold steady, enquiries improve.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers hold steady, enquiries improve.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes held steady Wednesday, despite the weakness of the cargo market, traders said.

Enquiries improved after news that Indonesian authorities boarded several tankers refuelling outside Singapore port limits, saying the ships were in Indonesia's territorial waters. "This helps enquiries within our port limits," said one trader.
The 380-cst was offered at above $100 per tonne and the 180-cst grade was $3-$4 per tonne higher.
MDO and gas oil stabilised at around $160 and $170 per tonne respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3571)
